notes: Menu: 7 items, pickup prices from papajohns.com store catalogue (product.getByStore API behind the store menu) at 3 carryout stores, one per state, observed 2026-11-12: NY store 4091 (343 Grand St, New York, NY 10002); IL store 4109 (230 W Division St, Chicago, IL 60610); AZ store 1913 (540 E Thomas, Phoenix, AZ 85003). Store IDs and ZIPs from stores.getCarryoutStores at city-hall coordinates (carryout open 2026-11-12). The /order/menu page itself still fails with ChunkLoadError (ISS-024), so the menu URL in each price is the store's viewStoreMenu page, and the data came from the store's catalogue API, not the rendered page. The API price is the catalogue displayPrice; it does not show a channel split, and no carryout-only price was separately observed (ISS-029). Sizes are chosen from the item names. Items with option-based prices (Create Your Own, sides with choices) were skipped. Deal: null. The homepage (https://www.papajohns.com/) says 'Some offers may be available online only' with no named direct-only offer and no terms page for it. Papa Rewards and percent-off codes are not in the schema. Delivery: no single delivery fee was observed. The delivery checkout chunks fail (ISS-024), and the store API has no fee field, so directDelivery is false (ISS-029). Markup: no chain-specific published figure was found, so the category default applies (est).
